# HTTP API

<!-- GENERATED by docs-site/scripts/gen. Do not edit; run `npm run gen` in docs-site/. -->

Every route `passporter-bridge` serves under `/v1`, read from its router.
Anything else is the PWA's static files (with the single-page fallback).
Request and response bodies are `crates/protocol` types; the
[bridge README](../../crates/bridge/README.md#api) has status codes and the
details behind each row, and [design §5](../design.md#5-bridge-api-sketch)
the rules every action follows (idempotency, stale guard, fixed verbs, audit
first).

**Access**: *session* routes need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a
15-minute session token from device pairing, or the static token where the
config opts in. The event stream cannot carry headers, so its first message
is the token. *Public* routes are the pairing handshake and the build
version.

| Method | Path | Access | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/v1/actions` | session | The only mutating endpoint (design §5, protocol `action` and `result`). |
| GET | `/v1/agents` | session | Every agent, as a bare JSON array of `Agent`s ordered by pane, each with its latest turn headline and, while it works, its status line, or while it is blocked, what it asks. |
| POST | `/v1/agents` | session | Starting a new agent from the phone: `GET /v1/projects` and `POST /v1/agents` (protocol `spawn`). |
| POST | `/v1/agents/:id/car-reply` | session | Android Auto's spoken reply, mapped by the bridge so the phone stays a thin pipe. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/:id/commands` | session | The candidates of the agent's latest message. |
| POST | `/v1/agents/:id/commands/run` | session | Terminal mode: commands an agent asks the user to run, and the terminals those runs open. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/:id/pending` | session | What the agent is asking now: a `protocol::PendingInput` parsed from its screen while herdr reports it `blocked` (read fresh on every request), else `null`. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/:id/screen` | session | The agent's terminal tail for the keypad fallback: the visible viewport while it works, else the last `MAX_SCREEN_LINES` lines of recent output (where a dialog's question may have scrolled off the viewport). |
| POST | `/v1/agents/:id/status` | session | Remake a working agent's status line now (a tap on it; design §6.1, §6.4). |
| GET | `/v1/agents/:id/suggestions` | session | Short replies to a question at the end of an idle or done agent's last finished turn, offered as chips (a tap sends one; never sent without a tap). |
| GET | `/v1/agents/:id/thread` | session | The agent's thread after `since`, with its session's recent turn headlines. |
| GET | `/v1/agents/:id/tldr` | session | Without `turn`, the latest finished turn's TL;DR, which only a long turn has. |
| POST | `/v1/attachments` | session | Photo attachments (design §5, protocol `attachment`): `POST /v1/attachments` stores one image for the device that sent it, and a prompt naming it gets a line pointing the agent at the file. |
| POST | `/v1/audio` | session | With a JSON `NewUpload` declares a clip: `201` and its `UploadStatus` (`200` if the phone's own `audioId` was declared before, so a lost reply is harmless; a clip whose transcription failed is queued again). |
| GET | `/v1/audio/:id` | session | The status, for resuming after a restart. |
| PATCH | `/v1/audio/:id` | session | With `Upload-Offset: <n>` and raw bytes appends a chunk at `n`: `200` and the new status. |
| GET | `/v1/audio/:id/transcript` | session | The `Transcript` (`200`), or the status while it is pending (`202`) or once it failed (`422`). |
| POST | `/v1/auth/challenge` | **public** | A single-use challenge for a paired device to sign. |
| POST | `/v1/auth/pair` | **public** | Registers a device: its P-256 public key, with the one-time code `passporter pair` shows (single use, 5 minutes). |
| POST | `/v1/auth/session` | **public** | Exchanges a signed challenge for a 15-minute session token. |
| GET | `/v1/projects` | session | The projects and kinds this device may start; both empty when spawning is off. |
| GET | `/v1/push/key` | session | `{"vapidPublicKey": "<base64url>"}`, the PWA's `applicationServerKey`. |
| POST | `/v1/push/native` | session | Stores the caller's built-in notice subscription at the registration's reserved endpoint (new keys replace the old) and names the key that signs its notices. |
| GET | `/v1/push/native/:id/stream` | session | Streams the companion's newline-delimited JSON events of the caller's own registration (404 for any other), after `?since=<id>` if given. |
| GET | `/v1/push/subscriptions` | session | `{"subscriptions": [{"endpoint": "…"}]}`, this device's subscriptions. |
| POST | `/v1/push/subscriptions` | session | With `PushSubscription.toJSON()`: 201 when new, 204 when it replaced the one at that endpoint, 400 when invalid or not on an allowed push service, 409 when the device is at its limit. |
| DELETE | `/v1/push/subscriptions` | session | With `{"endpoint": "…"}`: 204, or 404 if this device has no such subscription. |
| GET | `/v1/runbooks` | session | Every runbook with its exact command, and its latest run. |
| POST | `/v1/runbooks/:name/run` | session | Runbooks: named, preconfigured operations the phone may run, by tap or by voice. |
| GET | `/v1/stream` | session (first message) | Upgrades a request to the event stream. |
| POST | `/v1/terminals/:pane/keys` | session | Allowlisted keys into a terminal this device's run opened. |
| GET | `/v1/terminals/:pane/screen` | session | The last lines of a terminal this device's run opened, while its pane still runs that terminal. |
| GET | `/v1/version` | **public** | The bridge's build. |

33 routes. Each description is the first sentence that the handler's doc comment, or its
module's, gives for the route.
